case.summary: Transaction 3503878 ($99.92, online, product code R) on card C07987-K2 triggered review at model risk score 0.9 as part of a seven-transaction episode totaling $816.62 across four days. The episode occurred from a device profile marked New to this account and shared with another account (C07727), which is consistent with account takeover patterns. The account has three prior confirmed fraud cases (out-of-region use and card-not-present fraud) and billing activity across 33 regions. Case memory returned eight structurally similar closed cases; all eight were confirmed fraud with no false alarms, all matching on shared device, account takeover pattern, and billing region. The cardholder's baseline is 248 lifetime transactions predominantly in-person and online at median $110.94. The assessed fraud probability is 0.62 with pattern confidence at 0.50. Given the strong historical precedent (8 of 8 similar cases confirmed fraud), the new device marker, the shared device link, and the prior fraud history, the evidence supports account takeover. However, fraud probability of 0.62 falls below the 0.70 threshold for block-without-verification per policy R1. Recommend VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER before any decline, as the case rests partly on device novelty which policy notes does not constitute proof. Confidence in fraud is moderately high but verification is required by policy.
